## Current position

**Doctoral Researcher, Department of Mathematics, University of Antwerp**  
Research in applied mathematics and optimization.

## Research interests

Nonsmooth and nonconvex optimization; high-order optimization; proximal and envelope methods; variational analysis; optimization for machine learning.
